name: FlickLock hypermotion — Cinematic Studio 3.5 with WHITE AirPods fix
iteration_reason: v1 (Seedance 2.0) generated the AirPods Pro 3 as BLACK instead of their real WHITE color because the prompt only mentioned 'matte black case' without specifying the AirPods inside are white. v2 switches to Higgsfield Cinematic Studio Video 3.5 (the premium DOP model) and rewrites the prompt with: (a) explicit WHITE AirPods Pro 3 specification with material detail (white silicone tips, white plastic body, silver metallic stems), (b) Higgsfield DOP cinematic camera language (dolly-in, tilt-up arc, orbital pan, anamorphic depth), (c) genre=drama for premium deliberate pacing.
prompt: Premium product film, Apple keynote and Dyson hypermotion aesthetic. Start frame: top-down macro of the matte BLACK AirPods Pro 3 case (the ESR Pulse FlickLock case), centered, with the mint-green FlickLock slider button and the small green status LED visible at center, exactly as in the start image. CAMERA WORK (cinematic DOP): slow dolly-in 8 percent over the first 2 seconds, locked on the slider. At second 2, a realistic human thumb enters from frame LEFT, makes physical contact with the mint-green slider, and pushes it LEFT TO RIGHT (rightward — matching the arrow direction on the slider button). The green status LED ignites with a soft bloom halo as the slider reaches its right end. Camera then performs a smooth tilt-up and arc, transitioning from top-down to a low three-quarter angle, while the magnetic lid slowly lifts and floats upward in slow motion (60 percent speed). The case opens revealing the WHITE AirPods Pro 3 inside — pure white silicone ear tips and white plastic body, with silver metallic stems that have small black sensor circles. Camera pulls back smoothly to a wider hero shot, then performs a slow 90-degree orbital pan revealing the side profile of the case. Final 1.5 seconds: smooth elegant fade to pure pitch black, holding on black. ABSOLUTE PRODUCT FIDELITY: the BLACK case body, the MINT-GREEN slider, the GREEN LED, and the WHITE AirPods Pro 3 (white tips, white body, silver stems) must remain visually identical to real product references throughout. The AirPods Pro 3 are WHITE, not black. The case is BLACK. Do not blend or confuse these colors. STRICT MOTION: slider slides LEFT TO RIGHT only. The thumb is photoreal, no uncanny detail. Color grade: warm-cool contrast, deep blacks, mint green and copper accents preserved. Anamorphic depth of field, shallow on close-ups. Genre: drama. No text overlays, no logos, no captions.
fidelity_constraints: AirPods Pro 3 INSIDE the case: WHITE body + WHITE silicone tips + SILVER METALLIC stems
Lid opens upward away from camera (magnetic motion)
